label: early original-phase q (and q/3-primed y/g/l/3) input
predicate: (phase == 0) & (t >= 1) & (t <= 3) & ((in_tok == tok("q")) | isin(prev_tok, [tok("q"), tok("3")]) & isin(in_tok, [tok("q"), tok("y"), tok("g"), tok("l"), tok("3"), tok("a"), tok("b")]))
explanation: Fires mostly early in the original phase (t=1-3 holds about 80% of mass; never at t=0, essentially never on <DEL>). The main driver is input q (58% of mass, 14.7x lift). It also fires more weakly on y/g/l/3 inputs, and more when the previous tokens were q or 3. The strongest activations are a q at t=2 after q or 3 (e.g. q q [q] or 3 q [q]). A weak tail of about 15% of mass is in the late copy phase of long sequences (y, j, 0, c outputs). Many early q inputs with no q/3 context do not fire (precision about 0.47), so it depends on hidden state beyond the current token. Dev F1 0.51, mass recall 0.72.
